items.title: 3.1.4 Polyatomic ions mein phaila hua octet (expanded octet) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 3.1.4, printed pages 49-50.

blocks.text: Polyatomic ions woh ions hain jo ek se zyada qism ke atoms se bane hain. Un ka formal charge un par kul charge hai, jo bonds banne ke baad un ke valence shells ke electrons ki tadaad se nikala jata hai. Ammonium ion NH4+ ke istisna ke saath yeh ions zyada tar manfi charge rakhte hain, misal ke taur par carbonate CO3 2-, sulfate SO4 2- aur nitrate NO3 -. Kuch polyatomic ions mein darmiyani atom apni electron density oonche orbitals mein phaila kar octet rule tor deta hai; inhen phaile hue octets (expanded octets) wale kaha jata hai. Numayan misalein SO4 2-, ClO4 - aur PO4 3- hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne nitrate ion ko NO3 3- chhapa hai. Nitrate par sirf ek manfi charge hai: N (+5) aur teen O (-2 har ek) milkar +5 - 6 = -1. Is liye sahi NO3 - hai.

blocks.alt: Sulfate ion ki Lewis structure, chakor brackets mein, oopar daen taraf 2- charge. Darmiyan mein sulfur, oopar aur neeche wale oxygen atoms se double bonds aur baen aur daen wale oxygen atoms se single bonds. Har double bond wale oxygen par do lone pairs aur har single bond wale oxygen par teen lone pairs. Brackets ke andar 'sulfate ion' likha hai.
blocks.caption: Sulfate ion ki Lewis structure (kitab mein matan ke saath chhapi structure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Darmiyani S ke gird ginein: do double bonds (2 x 4 = 8 electrons) aur do single bonds (2 x 2 = 4 electrons), kul 12. Yeh octet (8) se chaar zyada hai, isi ko phaila hua octet (expanded octet) kehte hain. Brackets ke bahar 2- poore ion ka charge hai.

SO4 2- ki Lewis structure se darmiyani sulfur atom ke gird electrons ki tadaad 2 x (double bond electrons) + 2 x (single bond electrons) = 2(4) + 2(2) = 12 hai. To sulfur ke valence shell mein 12 electrons hain aur woh octet se chaar zyada hai. Yeh phailao bonding mein d orbital ke shamil hone se hota hai, jo izafi electrons rakh sakta hai. Khalis S(0) atom ki configuration 3p orbitals mein do ghair-jure electrons dikhati hai; 3d orbital ki maujoodgi 3p jore se ek electron muntaqil kar ke ise chaar ghair-jure electrons tak phailane deti hai. Yeh na sirf sulfur ki mukhtalif oxidation states samjhata hai balke us ke d orbital mein izafi electrons qabool karne ki salahiyat bhi.

blocks.alt: Sulfur ke orbital dabbon (boxes) ki do qataarein, har ek mein ek 3s, teen 3p aur paanch 3d dabbe. Oopar wali qataar: 3s mein do ulte teer (jora), 3p mein ek jora aur do akele oopar teer, 3d khaali. Neeche wali qataar: 3s mein ek oopar teer, har 3p dabbe mein ek oopar teer, aur pehle do 3d dabbon mein ek ek oopar teer.
blocks.caption: Sulfur ke electron dabbe: electrons ke promotion se pehle aur baad 3s, 3p aur 3d orbitals (kitab ke chhape box diagrams ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Oopar wali qataar sulfur ki zameeni haalat (ground state) hai: 3p mein sirf do akele (unpaired) electrons. Neeche wali qataar mein electrons khaali 3d orbitals mein chale gaye hain. Kitab ka matan kehta hai ke 3p jore ka ek electron 3d mein jata hai aur chaar akele electrons bante hain; lekin chhapi hui neeche wali qataar mein ek 3s electron bhi 3d mein gaya hai, is liye chhe akele electrons hain (3s1 3p3 3d2). Sulfate mein S chhe bonds banata hai (do double + do single), is ke liye chhe akele electrons chahiye, to yeh chhapi qataar sulfate ke liye durust hai. Chaar akele electrons wali haalat (3s2 3p3 3d1) SO2 jaise compounds mein kaam aati hai.

blocks.alt: Tri-iodide ion ki Lewis structure: teen iodine atoms ek seedh mein, I-I-I, do single bonds se jure hue. Har iodine atom par teen lone pairs. Structure chakor brackets mein hai aur oopar daen taraf minus charge.
blocks.caption: Tri-iodide ion, [I3]-, ki Lewis structure (kitab mein chhapi structure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Isi tarah tri-iodide ion I3- ke darmiyani iodine atom ke gird valence electrons 2 x (single bond electrons) + 2 x (lone pairs) = 2(2) + 2(3) = 10 hain. Darmiyani iodine ke valence shell mein 10 electrons hain, aur octet do se phailta hai.

blocks.caption: Darmiyani atom ke electrons ginna
header: Darmiyani atom par bonds aur lone pairs

blocks.prompt: Kya period 2 ke anasir ka octet phail sakta hai? ClO3- aur PO4 3- mein phaile hue octets ka andaza lagayein aur wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation: Nahi: period 2 ke atoms (C, N, O, F) ke paas sirf 2s aur 2p orbitals hain, d orbitals nahi, to woh aath se zyada valence electrons nahi rakh sakte. Chlorine aur phosphorus period 3 mein hain aur khali 3d orbitals rakhte hain. ClO3- mein chlorine do double bonds aur ek single bond banata hai aur ek lone pair rakhta hai, 2(4) + 2(1) + 2(1) = 12 electrons; PO4 3- mein phosphorus ek double bond aur teen single bonds banata hai, 2(2) + 2(3) = 10 electrons. Dono 3d orbitals istemal kar ke octet se barhte hain.

items: Polyatomic ions mein ek se zyada qism ke atoms hain; zyada tar manfi hain (NH4+ istisna). Period 3 ya aage ka darmiyani atom apna octet d orbitals mein phaila sakta hai: SO4 2- mein S ke 12 valence electrons, I3- mein I ke 10.
